name: Coding scenario
description: Five small Python repositories, each with a coding task for an agent. The model works with holaOS's file tools and a tool that runs the visible tests; hidden tests that follow the same spec decide a pass. Each task runs 3 times with the vendor's recommended sampling. Budgets are tokens and turns, never seconds.
holaos_snapshot: read, edit, ls, find and search are copied unchanged from packs/agent-v1/tools-lean.json (holaOS main-session tools); write is pi-coding-agent 0.80.2's write schema

tasks.title: Fix a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test suite in this repo fails. Find the bug in the code and fix it so all tests pass. Don't change the tests.

tasks.title: Implement a function from its spec
tasks.prompt: Implement `parse_duration` in `durations.py`. Its docstring is the spec. Keep the signature.

tasks.title: Add a CLI option across files
tasks.prompt: Add a `--format` option to the inventory CLI. `--format table` is the current output and stays the default. `--format csv` prints the same items as CSV to stdout: a header row `sku,name,qty,unit_price`, then one row per item in the same order as the table, with `unit_price` to two decimals. Use Python's `csv` module so names containing commas are quoted. argparse should reject any other value.

tasks.title: Fix a reported bug
tasks.prompt: Support says: a customer typed the code `save10 ` (lowercase, with a trailing space) at checkout and it was rejected. They retyped it as `SAVE10` and their total for 3 × Widget at 19.99 came to 53.98. Our pricing policy (`docs/pricing.md`) says it should be 53.97. Fix the code so checkout follows the policy. Keep the existing tests passing.

tasks.title: Change a parser's core algorithm
tasks.prompt: Add the exponent operator `**` to the calculator in `calc/`. Follow Python's rules: it binds tighter than `*`, `/` and a unary minus on its left, so `-2 ** 2` is `-4`; it is right-associative, so `2 ** 3 ** 2` is `512`; and its right operand may start with a unary minus, so `2 ** -1` is `0.5`. `*` must work as before. Keep the existing tests passing.
